prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one high-fidelity widescreen 16:9 fantasy RPG UI screenshot, readable at 1280x720. The reference image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, its giant three-card arrangement must be redesigned for scalability. Retain premium colorful chunky hand-painted fantasy vistas and restrained midnight blue / cream / warm gold styling. This is a future-content INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE demonstration, not a claim these places already exist.
Primary request: show a genuinely scalable destination browser that handles MANY REGIONS and MANY DUNGEONS without expanding the window or shrinking text. A full-size panel about 1140x610 centered on softly blurred camp gameplay. STRONGLY PRIORITIZE usable UI geometry, clear typography, and proportionate ornaments. Three aligned columns, with visible separation but no nested ornamental frames.
HEADER: crisp title 远行目的地 at left, a search field containing placeholder 搜索地区或副本 at center-right, close X upper right.
LEFT COLUMN about 190px wide: label 地区目录. Compact VERTICAL SCROLLABLE navigation rows with tiny colorful landscape thumbnails. Show 苍风原野 selected, then 迷雾林地, 赤岩裂谷, 幽影湿地, 霜寒山脊, 沉沙古城, 破晓海岸, 远古高地. Last four have modest lock symbols. A subtle scroll thumb shows this is a long list. Left footer 共12个地区. Rows have generous readable hit targets, no huge landscape cards.
CENTER COLUMN about 550px: current region breadcrumb 苍风原野. Two tabs 野外探索 and 副本挑战, with 副本挑战 selected. Small availability filters 全部 / 可进入, 全部 selected. Below is a fixed 2-column by 3-row grid of SIX COMPACT LANDSCAPE DUNGEON TILES with clearly readable names and short status labels, each showing a tiny colorful view. Tile 1 荒原试炼 selected gold outline, 已开放, vista is sunlit grassy plains and a monumental stone gate; Tile 2 古桥遗迹, 已开放, old stone bridge over a river; Tile 3 风车地窟, 已通关, windmill above a grassy ravine; Tile 4 暮色矿井, 未解锁 with lock, dark mine in mountain; Tile 5 巨石祭坛, 未解锁 with lock, forest stone circle; Tile 6 失落城塞, 未解锁 with lock, ancient fortress. Keep locked scenery visible. Below this fixed grid, a neatly aligned pagination footer 共12个副本, prev/next chevrons, 1 / 2. Pagination must be BELOW the grid, not on each tile. All text at useful gameplay sizes.
RIGHT COLUMN about 300px: one selected-dungeon details area with large scenic hero preview of grassy monumental gate, title 荒原试炼, availability 已开放, a short line 首领：荒原守门人, a second short line 进入后挑战当前地区首领. At bottom a single clearly dominant, restrained gold button 进入副本. The selection tiles themselves do not immediately launch anything; this button confirms the chosen activity. No fake rewards, currencies, combat power, levels or difficulty selectors.
Subtle bottom panel caption 新增名称仅作扩展示例. Chinese typography must be accurately spelled, clean, crisp, very readable. Navy surfaces should feel clean rather than heavily textured or grubby. Strong scene variety, selected gold used sparingly, dark-mode text high contrast. No giant ornamental compass, no extra card layers, no diagonal hatching, no gigantic glowing plastic button. All navigation, six tiles, details, pagination and action fit comfortably inside frame. No photo of a physical device, no watermark, no external annotations.
